mentions.name: ZShot
mentions.description: A local-only browser tuned specifically for CLI and API usage — a headless browser for when you need a browser you don't look at. It can render a webpage as a PNG or MP4, or capture a site as a WACZ archive or SQLite database, and ships with a Mac app to help discover its options. It includes an internal agent framework for browser automation tasks like logging in, clicking a button, and taking a screenshot, which also automatically generates Playwright tests and can run Playwright and Puppeteer test suites. Multiple AI models can bounce control of the web session between each other, letting a cheaper model escalate to a stronger model (e.g., Opus) when needed.
mentions.problem: Fills the gap of needing a browser for local tooling and building services on top of, but without a visible interface — "I sure wish I had a browser, but not one to look at".
